thread:
incident-bot: Paging: Ravenwood (enterprise, dedicated pool eu-west-1) p99 latency spike above SLO (target 800ms) — current p99 2.4s. Immediate triage required. @eric_oncall are you available?

eric_oncall: on it. seeing alerts in console. p95 ~ 900ms, p99 2.4s, error rate nominal. customer reports degraded interactive latency. starting investigation.

maria_sre: I'm pulling perf histograms and recent deploys. any recent config changes for that dedicated pool?

ajay_platform: No deploys flagged to eu-west-1 in last 90m. autoscale metrics show pool at 96% GPU util on several hosts. suspect noisy tenant or cache churn.

sam_support: Ravenwood CS pinged us: "users experiencing slow responses in EU, some timed out calls." They ask for ETA for mitigation. I'll keep them posted.

rebecca_eng: Adding a quick check — listing top tenants by token/sec in the pool:
```
# top tenants (last 5m)
ravenwood: 62 tok/s
free-tier: 14 tok/s
analytics-svc: 9 tok/s
unknown-tenant-7: 58 tok/s
```

maria_sre: aha — unknown-tenant-7 is spiking and colocated with Ravenwood on same machines. probable noisy neighbor causing KV cache churn -> higher decode latency.

eric_oncall: can we isolate unknown-tenant-7 to a different pool? what's impact of immediate tenant move?

ajay_platform: We can migrate that tenant to warm spare pool in same region without global failover. Steps: 1) mark tenant for migration 2) drain new worker set 3) update routing rules for that tenant. Risk: short 100-300ms routing blip, should reduce p99 quickly.

rebecca_eng: I can run the migration. prepping commands.

deploy-bot: automated action required: approve tenant migration for `unknown-tenant-7`? Reply `approve` to proceed.

eric_oncall: approve — proceed with tenant migration now.

rebecca_eng: kicking off migration. running drain and route flip. logs:
```
2026-02-12T15:12:05Z drain-init unknown-tenant-7 -> 40 connections
2026-02-12T15:12:28Z route-update: unknown-tenant-7 -> warm-spare-eu-west-1
2026-02-12T15:12:34Z drain-complete 0 connections
```

maria_sre: monitoring metrics. p99 down to 980ms and trending. GPU util in main pool dropped to 78%. still watching for regression.

sam_support: Updated Ravenwood CS: "We're routing some traffic to warm spare; engineers expect latency to improve within a few minutes." CS asked for keepalive.

ajay_platform: Also enabled per-tenant KV pinning for Ravenwood to reduce cache misses (temporary).

rebecca_eng: confirmed p99 now 760ms, p95 420ms. Ravenwood reports interactive flows looking normal.

eric_oncall: marking incident as contained. Next steps: full throttle audit for unknown-tenant-7 and decide permanent isolation or rate limits. Assigning postmortem to rebecca_eng.

maria_sre: I've scheduled a follow-up runbook update to include noisy-tenant detection and automated tenant isolation threshold.

sam_support: I'll coordinate customer incident summary and send Ravenwood a timely post-incident note with mitigation details and ETA for RCA.

eric_oncall: On-call handoff: I'll stay on until 15:40Z then pass to ajay_platform for overnight watch.

incident-bot: Incident contained — severity: S2 (customer-visible latency, contained). Incident channel locked for war-room notes.

eric_oncall: closing thread for active mitigation. Add any lingering action items here.
